269: /**
270:  * Parses a bound resource URL into the target its gatekeeper needs.
271:  *
272:  * Throws on any URL that does not name a supported resource. There is deliberately no fallback
273:  * kind: the caller derives the resource — and hence the admin disable check and the recorded
274:  * `typeUrlPattern` — from what this returns, so guessing would mint a capability the URL never
275:  * described.
276:  */
277: export function parseResourceUrl(url: string): ResourceTarget {
278:   let parsed: URL;
279:   try {
280:     parsed = new URL(url);
281:   } catch {
282:     // Nothing of an unparseable string is safe to quote back.
283:     throw new Error("Not a valid resource URL.");
284:   }
285:   if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
286:     throw new Error(`Google resource URLs must use https, not ${parsed.protocol}`);
287:   }
288: 
289:   switch (parsed.hostname) {
290:     case "mail.google.com": return parseGmailUrl(parsed);
291:     case "docs.google.com": return parseDocsUrl(parsed);
292:     case "calendar.google.com": return parseCalendarUrl(parsed);
293:     case BIGQUERY_HOST: return parseBigQueryUrl(parsed);
294:     case "drive.google.com": return parseDriveUrl(parsed);
295:   }
296:   throw new Error(`Unsupported Google resource URL host: ${parsed.hostname}`);
297: }
298: 
299: /**
300:  * How much of a resource URL is safe to name in an error.
301:  *
302:  * A resource URL is caller-supplied and its tail is the sensitive part: a Gmail hash carries a
303:  * search query, and `href` retains any embedded credentials. These errors reach the Workshop UI and
304:  * are logged by their catchers, so only the host and path travel. The path still names a document
305:  * id, which is what makes the error worth reading at all -- but an id the caller just supplied and
306:  * the recorded binding will hold anyway, not a secret this adds to the trail.
307:  */
308: function describeUrl(parsed: URL): string {
309:   return `${parsed.hostname}${parsed.pathname}`;
310: }
311: 
312: /**
313:  * Gmail's own UI writes a hash of `#inbox`, `#search/<query>` or `#label/<name>`.
314:  *
315:  * The label is kept as an opaque name and resolved to an ID at session start, so label text can
316:  * never be interpreted as search syntax.
317:  */
318: function parseGmailUrl(parsed: URL): ResourceTarget {
319:   let hash = parsed.hash;
320:   if (hash.startsWith("#search/")) {
321:     // Gmail encodes spaces in hash searches as `+`, which decodeURIComponent does not decode.
322:     let query = decodeURIComponent(hash.slice("#search/".length).replace(/\+/g, " "));
323:     validateGmailQueryForGrouping(query);
324:     return { kind: "gmail", searchQuery: query };
325:   }
326:   if (hash.startsWith("#label/")) {
327:     let labelName = decodeURIComponent(hash.slice("#label/".length));
328:     validateGmailLabelName(labelName);
329:     return { kind: "gmail", labelName };
330:   }
331:   if (hash && hash !== "#inbox") {
332:     throw new Error(
333:       "Unsupported Gmail view. Connect the inbox, an explicit search, or an explicit label.");
334:   }
335:   return { kind: "gmail" };
336: }
337: 
338: function parseDocsUrl(parsed: URL): ResourceTarget {
339:   // Both forms are /<type>/d/<id>/..., so the id is always the third segment.
340:   let id = parsed.pathname.split("/")[3];
341:   if (parsed.pathname.startsWith("/document/d/")) {
342:     if (!id) throw new Error("Invalid Google Docs URL: no document ID found");
343:     return { kind: "doc", documentId: id };
344:   }
345:   if (parsed.pathname.startsWith("/spreadsheets/d/")) {
346:     if (!id) throw new Error("Invalid Google Sheets URL: no spreadsheet ID found");
347:     return { kind: "sheets", spreadsheetId: id };
348:   }
349:   throw new Error(`Unsupported Google Docs resource URL: ${describeUrl(parsed)}`);
350: }
351: 
352: function parseCalendarUrl(parsed: URL): ResourceTarget {
353:   if (!parsed.pathname.startsWith("/calendar/")) {
354:     throw new Error(`Unsupported Google Calendar resource URL: ${describeUrl(parsed)}`);
355:   }
356:   let calendarId = decodeURIComponent(parsed.pathname.split("/")[2] ?? "");
357:   if (!calendarId) {
358:     throw new Error("Invalid Google Calendar URL: no calendar ID found");
359:   }
360:   if (calendarId === "primary") {
361:     throw new Error(
362:       "Google Calendar bindings must use a stable calendar ID, not the account-relative " +
363:       "\"primary\" alias.");
364:   }
365:   // Least privilege unless the URL explicitly opts into all calendars.
366:   let availabilityMode: CalendarAvailabilityMode =
367:       parsed.searchParams.get("availability") === "allVisible" ? "allVisible" : "thisCalendar";
368:   return { kind: "calendar", calendarId, availabilityMode };
369: }
370: 
371: function parseDriveUrl(parsed: URL): ResourceTarget {
372:   if (/^\/drive\/my-drive\/?$/.test(parsed.pathname)) return { kind: "driveAccount" };
373: 
374:   let sharedDrive = /^\/drive\/folders\/([^/]+)\/?$/.exec(parsed.pathname);
375:   if (sharedDrive) return { kind: "sharedDrive", driveId: decodeURIComponent(sharedDrive[1]) };
376: 
377:   let file = /^\/file\/d\/([^/]+)\/view\/?$/.exec(parsed.pathname);
378:   if (file) return { kind: "driveFile", fileId: decodeURIComponent(file[1]) };
379: 
380:   throw new Error(`Unsupported Google Drive resource URL: ${describeUrl(parsed)}`);
381: }
382: 
383: function parseBigQueryUrl(parsed: URL): ResourceTarget {
384:   if (parsed.search || parsed.hash) {
385:     throw new Error("BigQuery resource URLs must not include query strings or fragments.");
386:   }
387: 
388:   // Synthetic path: /<projectId>/<datasetId>/<tableId> (each segment optional after the first).
389:   let segments = parsed.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).map(s => decodeURIComponent(s));
390:   if (segments.length > 3) {
391:     throw new Error(
392:         "BigQuery resource URLs must be /<projectId>, /<projectId>/<datasetId>, " +
393:         "or /<projectId>/<datasetId>/<tableId>.");
394:   }
395:   let [projectId, datasetId, tableId] = segments;
396:   if (!projectId) {
397:     throw new Error("BigQuery resource URLs must include a project ID.");
398:   }
399:   if (tableId && !datasetId) {
400:     throw new Error("Cannot scope to a table without specifying a dataset.");
401:   }
402:   return { kind: "bigquery", projectId, datasetId, tableId };
403: }
